notes.title: Update 1.1, bug fixes and quality of life
notes.content:
[h2]First quality of life bug fix update after the launch.[/h2]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
- Fixed enemy not catching behind walls
- Fixed a crash
- Fixed locations where player can get stuck
- Other small changes


[h3]Thanks everybody for playing the game! [/h3]

If you encounter bugs or have suggestions, join our discord and give us some feedback!
[url=https://discord.com/invite/FJWWNhu]Join our discord![/url]
ps(I have some unfortunate health battles, but hopefully we can update the game during the fall. :D)
